arabic_text: إِنَّ الدُّنْيَا سِجْنُ الْمُؤْمِنِ وَجَنَّةُ الْكَافِرِ
english_translation: The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.
question: What is the correct translation of the Arabic phrase 'إِنَّ الدُّنْيَا سِجْنُ الْمُؤْمِنِ وَجَنَّةُ الْكَافِرِ'?

options.A: The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.
options.B: The world is a test for the believer and a trial for the disbeliever.
options.C: The world is temporary for the believer and eternal for the disbeliever.
options.D: The world is a blessing for the believer and a curse for the disbeliever.

question: In which authentic Hadith collection is the Hadith 'The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever' found?

question: What is the main lesson taught by the Hadith 'The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever'?

options.A: Believers should avoid working in this world.
options.B: Disbelievers will never face any punishment.
options.C: Believers should focus on the Hereafter as worldly life involves restrictions and trials.
options.D: Believers are forbidden from enjoying lawful things in this world.
